QuestInfo.name: Eyes in the Bushes
QuestInfo.0:
While passing the bushes filled with Forget-Me-Nots, Pan was frightened out of his wits. 
When you asked, he said he saw eyes shining in the bush. 

#b* You can enter Hidden Street [Forget-Me-Not Bushes] through the map In the Forest 4.
QuestInfo.1:
Penni spotted something, then shouted towards the bushes.

The bushes shook...
and a silhouette slowly stepped out.
QuestInfo.2:
Out from the bushes stepped the last Spirit Guide, a wolf. 
You remembered the past life where you named him.

#bPaeon...#k
He bristled when he saw you, still angry over something you did in a past life, and he refused to listen to your apology.

But you need him to awaken your potential, and the Forest Master, so you pleaded for him to stay. 

Finally, he relented, agreeing to go with you at least until the Forest Master was out of danger.
